title: fix: repair selected replay navigation and historical audit CI
body:
## What changes

Repair the shared CI navigation and historical audit after #7000 became selected. The guide points to the current replay and retains #6030 as history. The historical audit uses its inspected commit, preserving every source hash and all original rejection/plan controls.

The shallow planning job now checks that the snapshot controls are registered; the full-history replay job runs all four integration controls. A fresh Git-free fixture verifies that onboarding needs no historical objects. This fixes the three missing-commit errors introduced by running those integration tests during planning.

Credit Clear1nsight's #7257 for the pinned historical checkout, unpaidmoon for the original audit, and the retained replay/planner authors. The navigation repair follows #7161 and ToikY's f2206e6. This PR isolates CI maintenance from their research submissions.

## Checks

- ["python", "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_research_historical_snapshot.py"]: passed (exit 0). unittest: 2 tests run; 0 failures; 0 errors; 0 skipped; 0 expected failures; 0 unexpected successes.
- ["python", "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_research_current_status.py"]: passed (exit 0). unittest: 6 tests run; 0 failures; 0 errors; 0 skipped; 0 expected failures; 0 unexpected successes.
- ["python", "-B", "scripts/research_package.py", "--package", "research/historical-selected-replay-gap"]: passed (exit 0).

## Not tested

Updated-head hosted CI is pending. No selected-family scientific cold replay or supplier proof is claimed. At original head a54cd49, the broad native run had 11 failures, 23 errors and 90 skips across 760 tests; seven representative failures also reproduce with unchanged main. Those native fixture/platform issues remain unrepaired, and the full native suite is not rerun for this scoped update. Historical checkouts use retained Git objects, not fresh network acquisition.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
